_setup: FIREBASE SETUP — fill the fields below from Firebase Console > Project settings > General > Your apps > Web app, then SAVE. Until apiKey is filled in, the game stays local-only and everything keeps working. Full steps: src/README.md, section 'Cloud sync (optional Firebase)'. Firebase web config is public-by-design; protection comes from firestore.rules (src/firestore.rules), never from hiding these values.
